notes: Full tile, conifer archetype. Cone of drooping tiers: tier radius falls linearly from the lowest (widest, most tilted) tier to a single-leader point (crossed triangle cards, "leaders"); every tier pad is tilted outward ("tilt") and the trunk ends inside the crown, so no bare spire shows. Trunk visible below the lowest tier. Clump-shaded atlas ("shade": "clumped", no speckle). Clumps are generated per tier; rct2.scenery_small.tcfs shares this geometry.
